create_LauncherConfig: create a LauncherConfig dataclass instance to configure job submission and monitoring behavior
configure_LauncherConfig_await_completio: configure LauncherConfig to set await_completion to False for non-blocking job submission
configure_LauncherConfig_debug: configure LauncherConfig to enable debug mode so commands are printed instead of submitted
configure_LauncherConfig_monitor_jobs: configure LauncherConfig to disable job monitoring by setting monitor_jobs to False
review_LauncherConfig_validate: review the LauncherConfig validate method to ensure it calls the parent BaseConfig validate
